title: Safety Arithmetic: A Framework for Test-time Safety Alignment of Language Models by Steering Parameters and Activations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) by using GPT-4 to evaluate model responses to harmful prompts from the NicheHazardQA, HEx-PHI, and NOINTENTEDIT datasets.
Calculating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) using a GPT-4 judge to evaluate model responses to toxic questions containing racist themes from the DangerousQA and NOINTENTEDIT datasets.
Evaluating model outputs using GPT-4 to calculate the Attack Success Rate (ASR) on toxic questions that focus on sexist adjectives from the DangerousQA dataset.
Assessing the proportion of unsafe responses (ASR) generated from toxic queries containing stereotypical content in the DangerousQA and NOINTENTEDIT datasets, utilizing GPT-4 as an evaluator.
